Legs.Against: FieldNoiseOracleClaims.SampleOracle, an independent transcription of the same hash-and-interpolate recipe in BigInteger that calls no Puck.Maths member and shares no line with FieldNoise.cs -- every domain-separation constant, the three-round avalanche mix, the corner-value sign extension and the quintic fade polynomial are computed from scratch, with a hand-derived floor-shift standing in for BigInteger's own division semantics wherever a value can go negative (FieldNoise.cs has no external published specification, so the constants necessarily match; what is independent is the arithmetic that consumes them)

Legs.Subject: ENVELOPE: only the flat Sample(ulong, FixedVector3) overload is pinned at exact values here. Sample(ulong, FixedPosition) (the hierarchical wide-lattice overload) and the octave-summing Sample(ulong, FixedVector3, int) are not retranscribed -- sampling.field-noise-periodicity-canary-and-distribution's own legs are what the coverage citation on those two continues to rest on, alongside its octave-wrap and distribution statements; a defect confined to the wide-lattice or octave path would not redden this case

Legs.Subject: a zero metallic index and a zero point count are both refused, each naming its own parameter

Pcg32XshRr.NextGaussianPair's empirical mean, variance, skew and kurtosis and six two-sided CDF bins, over 20000000 pairs — 40000000 samples — at state 2026 and stream 13. This is the full-volume statement the sampling family's ENVELOPE legs cite
Legs.Against: the closed-form standard normal's own moments (mean 0, variance 1, skew 0, kurtosis 3) and six two-sided Phi values at |z| of 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 2.5 and 3, hand-tabulated outside this tree. Every gate is the TIGHTER of a committed threshold and eight standard errors derived from the sample count in the same run: the four moment gates land at 1.0e-3, 1.79e-3, 3.10e-3 and 6.20e-3 against committed thresholds of 1e-3, 3e-3, 5e-3 and 2e-2, and the six CDF bins between 6.6e-5 and 6.1e-4 against a flat committed 1.5e-3. Measured margins at this volume run from 7.6x at the |z| within 2 bin to 31x at variance

Legs.Subject: the beyond-three-sigma tail frequency over the same 40000000 samples, measured at 2.70302e-3
Legs.Against: an exact BigInteger enclosure of P(|Z| beyond 3) from Oracles.EncloseGaussianTailBeyondThreeSigma — Gordon's classical inequality over e^4.5's own Taylor series and Oracles.Pi's Machin-derived pi, with no offline double anywhere in the reference — widened by a statistical margin of 6.87e-5, the tighter of a committed 3e-4 and eight binomial standard errors at this volume. The measurement lands INSIDE the enclosure itself, so at forty million samples the statistical margin is not what carries the leg; the enclosure's own roughly ten per cent width is

Legs.Subject: consumption AT SCALE: twenty million pairs consume exactly forty million advances, read off the generator's State at the end of the run against a twin moved by a single Advance(40000000) call. Checked after the whole run rather than per draw, so a per-pair advance count that drifted anywhere in forty million draws is caught, which a probe at the front of the stream cannot promise

ENVELOPE: a DISTRIBUTIONAL statement that pins no individual draw and reaches no line of the Box-Muller kernel's own arithmetic — the value contract, the roughly 6.66 sigma cap and the two-advance consumption at everyday volume are sampling.pcg-reference-vector-and-state's. It is also a statement at ONE seed: a generator wrong on some other stream is not reached here. Mutation-probed: scaling every sample by 1.01 reddens it at 'variance 1.0101060 departs from 1 by more than 1.7889E-003', and moving the tail cut from 3.0 to 3.05 reddens it at 'tail P(|z| beyond 3) 2.28900E-003 is outside [2.59046E-003, 3.02322E-003]'; both restored before landing. Runtime is about two seconds, so the Deep sibling sampling.gaussian-moments-cdf-tail buys less by its tenfold reduction than its own envelope implies

Pcg32XshRr.Shuffle over a four-element span produces all 24 permutations, each within 700 of the uniform 20000, over 480000 trials at state 777, stream 30. Uniformity over the whole symmetric group on four letters is the one statement a Fisher-Yates transcription cannot make about itself: the transcription leg in sampling.pcg-reference-vector-and-state proves the walk is CARRIED faithfully and says nothing about whether the walk is unbiased, and this is the row that does. The histogram is a flat 256-slot array keyed two bits per position rather than a string dictionary — the same statement with no per-trial allocation

two companion rows at a second seed (state 5, stream 31) over eight elements: two identically seeded generators shuffle to the identical ordering position for position, and the result is a permutation — every one of the eight elements survives exactly once, read off an occupancy mask rather than by sorting

ENVELOPE: 480000 trials over FOUR elements. Twenty-four cells is the largest symmetric group a frequency test at this volume resolves, so nothing here states the shuffle is unbiased at larger spans, and the 700-of-20000 band is about five standard errors of the uniform binomial — it separates a structurally biased shuffle rather than measuring a small bias. Mutation-probed: shuffling only the first three of the four elements reddens it at 'permutation 0123 occurred 79624 times over 480000 trials, expected 20000 +/- 700'; restored before landing. Runtime is a few hundredths of a second, which is why the Deep sibling sampling.shuffle-permutation-uniformity's halved trial count bought nothing worth having

the alias table's draw frequencies over six weight shapes — small integer ratios, a uniform four-way split, three interleaved zeros, a singleton, a one-to-a-trillion ratio and a 257-way vector — 36100000 draws in all
Legs.Against: each entry's construction weight over the total, compared EXACTLY: the departure, count times total minus draws times weight, is formed in BigInteger and no floating-point ratio enters the comparison. Only the BAND is float — eight binomial standard errors, floored at 2e-9 so a vanishing probability still has one. What makes this classical rather than a restatement is that the construction weights are the caller's input while the Vose partition built from them is the thing under test: the two sides share no code and no rounding substrate

Legs.Subject: the rows the distribution alone does not state, read off the same 36100000 draws: every selected index lies inside [0, Count), Count is the CONSTRUCTION length at each of the six shapes rather than the padded column count, and no zero-weight entry is EVER selected — which the interleaved-zero shape asserts at three entries and the 257-way vector asserts at one zero buried at index thirteen, where a partition that let a zero column reach an alias slot would surface only under a long run

construction determinism at each of the six shapes: a second table built from the identical entries samples identically over 10000 draws from an identically seeded generator, so the Vose partition's own tie-breaking is pinned as reproducible rather than assumed

ENVELOPE: the 257-way weight vector is drawn from Pcg32XshRr rather than System.Random, whose sequence is not a stable contract across runtimes — only the SHAPE of the vector is fixed and the exact weights are not, which is a deliberate determinism choice. Not reached here: the refusal ladder, the allocation-priced ordering probes and the fixed-point weight overloads, all of which are sampling.alias-refusal-and-fixed-twins'. Mutation-probed: rotating the constructed weights by one entry while comparing against the unrotated vector reddens it at 'small-integer-ratios[0]: weight 1 of 10 drew 1600688 of 8000000, departing by 8006880 against the 8-sigma allowance 67883'; restored before landing. Runtime is under half a second

CertifiedLowDiscrepancy.DiscrepancyBound at SIX certificates spanning K of 1, 2, 2, 6, 14 and 100 — golden, silver, root two, root thirteen, root fifty and root 2501, each named beside the continued-fraction expansion its certificate comes from — at every one of five point counts: 64, 256, 1024, 4096 and 16384. Across-scales is the whole point of the row: a bound that happened to dominate at one N says nothing about its 1/N term, and thirty measurements over a 256-fold range of N are what this row carries
Legs.Against: the EXACT star discrepancy of the generated points, the maximum over i of the larger of (i+1)/N minus x_i and x_i minus i/N, formed in BigInteger over a common denominator of N times two-to-the-thirty-two and compared with the bound by cross-multiplication, so no rounding enters anywhere and no double is sorted

Legs.Subject: teeth at three of those scales: the K of 100 certificate measures more than TWICE the K of 1 certificate at 1024, 4096 and 16384 points, and the three certificates 1, 2 and 14 measure strictly monotone at every one of them. A certificate that was merely a number carried alongside the sequence would satisfy the bound leg above and fail this one

coverage at all six certificates: no sequence leaves an empty circular gap wider than a twentieth of the unit interval over its first 4096 points, computed exactly on the raw UQ0.32 values with the wrap-around gap included, so a sequence that clustered its points and left the rest of the interval bare is reported rather than passed by the discrepancy bound alone

determinism at 200000 points: two independently constructed instances of the golden generator agree bit for bit at every index, which is what lets a certificate be rebuilt from its four integers instead of persisted

ENVELOPE: the certified bound is a classical UPPER bound and is NOT tight, and this case states how loose rather than leaving a reader to find out. Mutation-probed: the bound leg still holds with the bound QUARTERED and reddens with it cut to an eighth — at N of 64 the bound is 0.1875 against a measured 0.02897 — so what the leg separates is a badly wrong bound, never the bound's constant. The teeth leg was probed too: substituting a second golden sequence for the K of 100 one reddens the case at 'K=100 discrepancy 8115527680 is not more than twice K=1's 8115527680 at N=1024'. Both restored before landing. The certificates themselves are not pinned here beyond the six declared values; certified.certificate-vs-partial-quotients is what compares them with Oracles.MaximumPartialQuotient. Runtime is well under a second
